# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(xgboost)
  library(PRROC)
  library(ggplot2)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- normalizePath(file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, ".."), mustWork = FALSE)

OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
XGB_DIR    <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "xgBoost_outputs")
MODEL_DIR  <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "models")
PRED_DIR   <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictions")

run_name <- "xgBoost_LOCTO_featureAblation"

data_file <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "data.tsv")
training_file  <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", "eqtl_files",
                            "training_data_snppg_ALL_chr123.tsv.gz")

model_dir <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, run_name)
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 2. Load Data
```{r}
full_data <- fread(data_file)
training_data  <- fread(training_file)
```

# 3. Select Groups
```{r}
groups <- list(
  distance      = c("snp_gene_distance","peak_gene_distance","closest_tss","distNearest_peakCentric"),
  acc_mean      = c("ATACmean","peak_logCPM"),
  acc_var       = c("ATACvariance"),
  coaccess      = c("cicero","scent","signac"),
  motif_arch    = c("rex"),
  predEnhancer  = c("predEnhancer_g_exp_beta","predEnhancer_g_exp_score",
                    "predEnhancer_g_lin_beta","predEnhancer_g_lin_score",
                    "predEnhancer_p_exp_beta","predEnhancer_p_exp_score",
                    "predEnhancer_p_lin_beta","predEnhancer_p_lin_score"),
  topology_3d   = c("tad_n_boundaries","tad_pyt_score","tad_sum_score"),
  conservation  = c("conservation"),
  gene_expr     = c("gene_logCPM")
)

groups <- lapply(groups, function(v) intersect(v, names(full_data)))
groups <- groups[lengths(groups) > 0]
baseline_feats <- sort(unique(unlist(groups)))
stopifnot(length(baseline_feats) > 0)

cat("Baseline feature count:", length(baseline_feats), "\n")
```

# 4. Merge
```{r}
index_cols <- c("peak","gene","celltype","snp","chr")

ct_map <- c(
  Ast = "astrocytes",
  MG  = "Microglia",
  OD  = "Oligodendrocytes",
  OPC = "OPC",
  IN  = "Neurons",      # fuse IN → Neurons
  Ext = "Neurons",      # fuse Ext → Neurons
  End = "Endothelial"
)

training_data[, celltype := ifelse(celltype %in% names(ct_map),
                                   ct_map[celltype], celltype)]
stopifnot(all(index_cols %in% names(full_data)), all(index_cols %in% names(training_data)))
setkeyv(full_data, index_cols)
setkeyv(training_data, index_cols)
data <- full_data[training_data, nomatch = 0L]

# Labels 1=pos, 2=strong neg → 0/1
data[label == 2L, label := 0L]
data <- data[label %in% c(0L,1L)]
```

# 5.  Held-out cell types
```{r}
# Recompute held-outs AFTER mapping/join, so LOCTO sees the exact same CT names as baseline
LOO_colname <- "celltype"
heldouts <- sort(unique(as.character(data[[LOO_colname]])))
cat("Held-out cell types:", paste(heldouts, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Make sure the features actually exist post-merge
groups <- lapply(groups, function(v) intersect(v, names(data)))
groups <- groups[lengths(groups) > 0]
baseline_feats <- sort(unique(unlist(groups)))
stopifnot(length(baseline_feats) > 0)
```

# 6. Metric Helpers
```{r}
logloss <- function(y, p, eps = 1e-15) {
  p <- pmin(pmax(p, eps), 1 - eps)
  -mean(y*log(p) + (1 - y)*log(1 - p))
}

score_fold <- function(y_true, p_hat) {
  stopifnot(all(y_true %in% c(0,1)))
  both_classes <- any(y_true==1) && any(y_true==0)
  if (both_classes) {
    pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = p_hat[y_true==1],
                          scores.class1 = p_hat[y_true==0], curve = FALSE)
    ro <- PRROC::roc.curve(scores.class0 = p_hat[y_true==1],
                           scores.class1 = p_hat[y_true==0], curve = FALSE)
    auprc <- pr$auc.integral; auc <- ro$auc
  } else {
    auprc <- NA_real_; auc <- NA_real_
  }
  data.table(auprc = auprc,
             auc   = auc,
             logloss = logloss(y_true, p_hat))
}

```

# 7. Run loCTo Function
```{r}
run_locto <- function(feat_set, tag = "baseline", save_models = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(length(feat_set) > 0)
  per_fold <- rbindlist(lapply(heldouts, function(h) {
    tr_idx <- data[[LOO_colname]] != h
    va_idx <- !tr_idx

    X_tr <- as.matrix(data[tr_idx, ..feat_set])
    y_tr <- data$label[tr_idx]
    X_va <- as.matrix(data[va_idx, ..feat_set])
    y_va <- data$label[va_idx]

    bst <- xgboost::xgboost(
      data             = X_tr,
      label            = y_tr,
      max_depth        = 6,
      eta              = 0.05,
      gamma            = 10,
      min_child_weight = 6,
      subsample        = 0.8,
      colsample_bytree = 1.0,
      nrounds          = 1000,
      nthread          = 2,
      objective        = "binary:logistic",
      eval_metric      = "auc",
      verbose          = 1
    )

    if (save_models) {
      xgboost::xgb.save(bst, file.path(model_dir, sprintf("xgb_locto_%s_%s.model", tag, h)))
    }

    p_hat <- predict(bst, X_va)
    mets  <- score_fold(y_va, p_hat)  
    cbind(data.table(heldout = h, n_val = length(y_va), run_tag = tag), mets)
  }))

  summary <- per_fold[, .(
    auprc   = mean(auprc,   na.rm = TRUE),
    auc     = mean(auc,     na.rm = TRUE),
    logloss = mean(logloss, na.rm = TRUE)
  )]

  list(per_fold = per_fold, summary = summary)
}
```

# 8. Run Baseline
```{r}
cat("Training baseline with", length(baseline_feats), "features …\n")
base_run <- run_locto(baseline_feats, tag = "base", save_models = TRUE)
print(base_run$summary)
fwrite(base_run$per_fold, file.path(model_dir, "baseline_per_fold.tsv"), sep = "\t")

```

# 9. Run Ablations
```{r}
ablation_rows <- lapply(names(groups), function(g) {
  drop <- groups[[g]]
  keep <- setdiff(baseline_feats, drop)
  runG <- run_locto(keep, tag = paste0("drop_", g), save_models = TRUE)

  # paired deltas by the same held-out cell type
  d_per_fold <- merge(
    runG$per_fold[, .(heldout, auprc_ab=auprc, auc_ab=auc, logloss_ab=logloss)],
    base_run$per_fold[, .(heldout, auprc_base=auprc, auc_base=auc, logloss_base=logloss)],
    by = "heldout"
  )[, .(
    d_auprc   = auprc_ab   - auprc_base,
    d_auc     = auc_ab     - auc_base,
    d_logloss = logloss_ab - logloss_base
  )]

  data.table(
    group    = g,
    n_drop   = length(drop),
    n_keep   = length(keep),
    auprc    = runG$summary$auprc,
    auc      = runG$summary$auc,
    logloss  = runG$summary$logloss,
    d_auprc  = mean(d_per_fold$d_auprc,   na.rm = TRUE),
    d_auc    = mean(d_per_fold$d_auc,     na.rm = TRUE),
    d_logloss= mean(d_per_fold$d_logloss, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
})

ablation_tbl <- rbindlist(ablation_rows)[order(d_auprc)]
print(ablation_tbl)

# Save table
fwrite(ablation_tbl, file.path(model_dir, "ablation_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")
```

# 10. Plot
```{r}
p <- ggplot(ablation_tbl, aes(x = reorder(group, d_auprc), y = d_auprc)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Feature group removed", y = "ΔAUPRC vs baseline (paired)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

print(p)
ggsave(file.path(model_dir, "ablation_delta_auprc.png"), p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

```
